import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2af46b08.py')
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c]!=bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]; edge=False
        while q:
          y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
          if y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1: edge=True
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
              seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
        if not edge:
          color=7 if len(cells)%2 else 2
          for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=color
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True); p.write_text(code)
